nodes.name: Daily 10:00
nodes.notes: 10:00 and not the small hours: the orchestrator sends at 9:00 and finishes within minutes, so the keys written today leave Supabase within the hour. And the 11:30 daily watch gets to report whether this worked THE SAME DAY. See design B-A. STAYS DISABLED until the group 9 Go/No-Go.

nodes.name: Read Sends
nodes.notes: READ ONLY. Each row comes out as jsonb so the microseconds of the dates are not lost (fix 2026-09-10, design B-F). Schema-qualified (bot.sends, never sends) because the node's 'schema' parameter only applies to table operations, not to raw SQL. alwaysOutputData so that an empty table still produces an item and the backup is not skipped silently.

parameters.query:
-- to_jsonb(e) and not select *: the n8n Postgres node turns every timestamptz
-- into a JavaScript Date, which only goes down to milliseconds, and the backup
-- lost the microseconds. Inside a jsonb the dates travel as ISO text, exact.
-- And unlike a column list, a new column gets in on its own: an explicit
-- list would leave it out of the backup without warning (design B-F).
select to_jsonb(e) as row
from bot.sends e
order by e.created_at, e.unique_key;

nodes.name: Build File
nodes.notes: Returns ONE item with the file in binary.data. If the Code node failed because of Buffer, the alternative is a Convert to File node.

nodes.name: Upload To Bucket
nodes.notes: S3 backup credential assigned on 2026-09-10. The endpoint needs an EXPLICIT https://: B2 shows it without a scheme and pasting it as-is fails with 'HTTP(S) Scheme is required in endpoint definition' (design B-H). The error output (main[1]) goes to the alert, not to a node that discards it. No delete node, on purpose: design B-C.

nodes.name: Mark Backup
nodes.notes: THE ONLY WRITE IN THE WHOLE CHANGE, and it does not touch bot.sends (design B-E). It is the evidence the daily watch reads: if this mark is older than 24 h or missing, the report alerts. That way 'the backup did not run' becomes visible the next day instead of never. queryReplacement as an ARRAY (debt 5.13).

nodes.name: Notify Failure
nodes.notes: INV-15: EXPLICIT parse_mode HTML and & < > escaped. Omitting it does not disable parsing -n8n sends Markdown anyway- and a provider error with an odd number of underscores would kill the alert with a 400, right when it is needed.

parameters.text:
={{ ('BACKUP FAILED

The bot.sends backup could not be uploaded to the bucket.

Error: ' + ($json.error?.message ?? $json.error ?? 'no detail') + '

The last_backup mark was NOT updated, so the daily watch will report it tomorrow as well.').replaceAll('&','&').replaceAll('<','<').replaceAll('>','>') }}
